title: Between about 3 and 5, children follow that others have their own thoughts and feelings
summary: OpenStax says that between 3 and 5 years old, children come to follow that other people have thoughts, feelings, and beliefs different from their own.
body: OpenStax Psychology says Piaget described 2- and 3-year-yeargroup as egocentric, without an awareness of other people's points of view. Between 3 and 5 years, the page says, children come to follow that people have thoughts, feelings, and beliefs different from their own. It calls that understanding theory of mind, and says children can then recognize that others have false beliefs. This is a textbook summary of that change. It is not the sheet milestone that most children notice someone else's distressed by about 2 years, and it is not a test score.
